newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Motors to build 1 mln autos in '97.
newsitem.headline: Kia Motors to build 1 mln autos in '97.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp plans to build one million vehicles in 1997 compared to this year's target of 800,000 units, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
Kia, South Korea's second largest autombile manufacturer, plans to export 400,000 of its vehicles in 1997 and leave 600,000 for the domestic market, the spokesman said.

That compares with a 1996 target of 300,000 units for export and 500,000 for the domestic market. To meet the 1997 target, Kia will run its facilities at full capacity next year rather than pour money into expansion, the spokesman told Reuters.
Kia made the forecast at a recent executive meeting, the spokesman said.
